source: Bimba — M · Subsystem: the live coordinate lattice of the Epi-Logos graph (the Bimba Atlas navigation ground)

provenance.ground: live Bimba graph: Neo4j 5.26 Community at bolt://100.92.62.101:7687 (HTTP http://100.92.62.101:7474, auth disabled) on the oi-omarchy docker host, served through Work/epi/bimba-portable (stateless MCP 2026-07-28); 2141 :Bimba nodes at capture

generator.name: collections/bimba/tools/bimba-snapshot.mjs — read-only Cypher over the Neo4j HTTP transactional endpoint; no graph writes; bimba-portable read conventions (bimba:read only)

provenance.slice_rule: every :Bimba node whose coordinate contains neither '-' nor '.' — the complete top-level coordinate lattice: six QL families C/P/L/S/T/M (Category, Position, Lens, Subsystem, Stack, Thought), each with its root, prime, positions 0-5 and position primes, plus the # ground row, the CF/CFP/CP/CPF/CT/CS composite roots, the CF_* forms, the Family_* descriptors and the four Weave_* crossings; deep branch coordinates (e.g. M2-5-9) are outside the slice. This manifest carries the group: M · Subsystem
provenance.exclusions: embedding vector properties (embedding, c_5_embedding) excluded as model-derived and regenerable; embedding metadata (model, dimensions, task type, generated_at) retained
provenance.graph_content_hash_basis: sha256 over the canonical JSON (sorted keys, no whitespace) of the ordered lattice slice [{coordinate, uuid, labels, properties}] with vector properties excluded — recomputable from the live graph and from the committed member documents, so drift is checkable with --verify
provenance.regeneration: node collections/bimba/tools/bimba-snapshot.mjs (capture) or --verify (drift check) under collections/bimba/tools, env BIMBA_HTTP
provenance.atlas_disposition: the travelling-jigsaw Atlas surface is already carried by its committed corpus journey (roz-mytheme-travelling-jigsaw-atlas, return-of-zero mytheme family); the Bimba Atlas navigation ground itself is what this collection binds, as exact-source lattice snapshots
